Package edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data

Class RTGPSData

java.lang.Object
edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data.RTFudgedData
edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data.RTGPSData
public class RTGPSData extends RTFudgedData
Mutable GPS acquisition with decimal-degree coordinates, MSL altitude in metres and dimensionless dilution-of-precision fields.

    • RTGPSData

      public RTGPSData(float lat, float lon, float alt, float p, float v, float h, boolean hF)
      Creates a RTGPSData with the supplied dependencies and per-instance state.
      Parameters:
      lat - latitude in decimal degrees
      lon - longitude in decimal degrees
      alt - GPS altitude in metres above mean sea level
      p - position dilution of precision
      v - vertical dilution of precision
      h - horizontal dilution of precision
      hF - whether a 3D fix is available
